programme.title: Caught Stealing
programme.desc: 1990s. Former baseball player Hank Thompson (Austin Butler) works as a bartender in a New York pub.He has a great girlfriend (Zoë Kravitz) and a championship-fighting team.His calm and orderly life changes when his neighbor Russ (Matt Smith) asks him to look after his cat for a few days.Then, out of nowhere, a gang of gangsters attacks Hank.Puerto Ricans, Russians and Jews are out to get him and he has no idea why.He will only find out what's going on if his wits and luck allow him to stay alive long enough.

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the day of his fifth wedding anniversary with Amy (Rosamund Pike), Nick Dunne (Ben Affleck) reports to the police that his wife has disappeared in mysterious circumstances.The case of her disappearance quickly reaches the media.Detective Rhonda Boney (Kim Dickens) leading the investigation discovers numerous inconsistencies in the man's testimony.There are speculations that Nick may have had something to do with Amy's mysterious disappearance.Supported by his twin sister, Margo (Carrie Coon), the man desperately tries to prove his innocence.Over time, new facts come to light which show that the Dunnes' marriage was a toxic relationship.The film by the creator of the cult thriller "Seven", David Fincher, was nominated, among others,to the Golden Globe.For her role as Amy, Rosamund Pike received nominations for an Oscar, a Golden Globe and other awards.The film's script, also nominated for a Golden Globe, was based on the best-selling novel by Gillian Flynn.

programme.title: karina jane austin
programme.desc: Jane Hayes (Keri Russell) is thirty years old, single and loves Jane Austen's novels.In men, she looks for similarities to Mr. Darcy, the hero of "Pride and Prejudice", played by Colin Firth years ago.One day, the woman decides to spend all her savings to go to Great Britain, following in the footsteps of her beloved writer.There he goes to a residence for Jane Austen enthusiasts.The woman doesn't think it will be the most beautiful trip of her life.A warm comedy intended for fans of Jane Austen's works.The film, nominated for an award at the Sundance Film Festival, was directed by Jerushy Hess.The screenplay was based on the novel of the same title by Shannon Hale.The main character was played by Golden Globe winner Keri Russell (series "Felicity", "The Magic of Ordinary Days").

programme.title: Gli addestratori
programme.desc: A somewhat clumsy but passionate dog trainer, Pasquale Marolla (Pasquale Petrolo), dreams of opening his own training center for dogs.Unfortunately, he loses the competition and a bet with his ex-wife, Marta (Geppi Cucciari), which causes the woman to take away his beloved pet, the border collie Cecchino.To get money and prove to the woman that he is enterprising, the man advertises a summer course for dogs.He is very surprised when he discovers that, as a result of a mistake, instead of pets, several children come to him.At first he can't cope with them, but then he comes up with a clever idea.Over time, the entire group begins to form an extraordinary bond, and through laughter and shared challenges, both Pasquale and the children learn true values: friendship, respect and sensitivity.

programme.title: Gaga Chromatica Ball
programme.desc: The performance of the famous singer Lady Gaga recorded in 2022 at Dodger Stadium in Los Angeles.The concert, which was part of The Chromatica Ball's tour promoting its sixth album, took place in front of an audience of 52,000.The singer performed, among others:their greatest hits, such as "Stupid Love", "Bad Romance", "Just Dance", "Poker Face", "Shallow", and "Rain On Me".The whole is complemented by songs played on the piano, amazing choreography, spectacular pyrotechnics and the artist's spectacular stylings.

programme.desc: The Herdman clan has a bad reputation in the town.Unruly siblings steal and bully their peers.Wherever he appears, he causes chaos and goes completely unpunished.Meanwhile, the residents, under the direction of the newly elected organizer, Grace (Judy Greer), are preparing for the annual Christmas nativity play.To everyone's surprise, Gladys Herdman (Kynlee Heiman) and her relatives want to appear in the show.Grace casts a girl as Mary, which complicates preparations for the play and causes widespread dissatisfaction.

programme.desc: Solene (Anne Hathaway) is the owner of an art gallery.One day, a divorced woman accompanies her daughter to a concert and meets her musical idol - the singer of the boy band Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), about whom teenagers fantasize.Despite the significant age difference, they both feel that they have a lot in common.They start an affair.Paparazzi make their romantic moments miserable.The revelation of a young musician's relationship with a middle-aged single mother turns out to be a media sensation.An unusual love story with a script based on the novel by Robinne Lee.

programme.title: House of the Dragon 2
programme.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

programme.desc: Two ice hockey players, Shane Hollander (Hudson Williams) and Ilya Rozanov (Connor Storrie), are united not only by ambition and the need for competition, but also by a magnetic attraction that neither of them fully understands.What begins as a secret romance between two debutants turns into an extraordinary love journey.Athletes spend eight years chasing fame on the ice rink while trying to deal with their feelings off it.They must decide whether there is room for something as fragile as love in a world of brutal competition.

programme.desc: Valerie Cherish, a once popular television actress, rose to fame as a sitcom star.After many years, he wants to return to the small screen at all costs.He decides to take part in a new reality show.

programme.title: Rooster
programme.desc: Greg Russo (Steve Carell) has written a best-selling series of books, and readers identify him with his literary hero nicknamed Rooster.A famous writer comes to the university campus to support his daughter (Charly Clive) who is going through a marital crisis in a difficult moment.Her partner has just left her for a student, which everyone knows perfectly well.The situation is further complicated by scandals involving a woman who are the subject of gossip in the academic community.The father declares help, but his presence quickly reveals old conflicts and uncomfortable topics, instead of bringing the expected solution.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Peacemaker 2
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the last events.Chris Smith (John Cena) considers himself a real hero.However, he must earn the recognition of other heroes.

programme.title: Half Man
programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: Danica and her friends cause an accident.They enter into a pact of silence rather than face the consequences.A year later, the secret is revealed - someone knows what they did and wants revenge.

programme.title: Guy Ritchie's the Covenant
programme.desc: March 2018.There is a war in Afghanistan.Master Sergeant John Kinley (Jake Gyllenhaal) and his unit are ambushed by the Taliban during a routine vehicle inspection.The American translator dies in it.He will be replaced by Ahmed Abdullah (Dar Salim).During a secret mission, Kinley learns that his new associate had previous ties to the Taliban.He escaped when the organization murdered his son.Over time, an alliance develops between him and the American soldier.Ahmed saves John, who after some time gains the opportunity to repay his debt.

programme.title: Insomnia
programme.desc: It's a polar summer in northern Alaska.Police officer Will Dormer (Al Pacino) arrives in the town of Nightmute with his partner Hap Eckhart (Martin Donovan).The men are to find the perpetrator of the murder of a seventeen-year-old girl.Will doesn't feel comfortable up north.The polar summer deepens his insomnia.The trail leads to writer Walter Finch (Robin Williams), who was friends with the victim.While chasing him in the thick fog, Will shoots his partner.Hap dies.In his last words, he accuses Will of doing it to prevent an internal investigation.Dormer covers his tracks by directing suspicions at Finch.A writer who witnessed Hap's murder begins to blackmail Will.Meanwhile, local policewoman Ellie Burr (Hilary Swank) is getting closer to discovering the truth about Hap's death.

programme.title: Gaisrai
programme.desc: Anna Arnardóttir, a renowned volcanologist, notices signs of dangerous eruptions near Reykjavík.Despite the warnings, the authorities do not believe her.The affair with the photographer also complicates the woman's private life.

programme.title: Barry
programme.desc: Barry (Bill Hader) is a low-end hitman.He is depressed, feels lonely and burnt out.Despite his reluctance, he accepts an assignment in Los Angeles, where he is to eliminate a young, aspiring actor.While tracking his target, he comes across a meeting of a theater group.Surprisingly, he feels great in the company of artists.Under their influence, he comes to the conclusion that he would like to break up with his current profession.However, it is not that simple.The originators of the series are Alec Berg, a five-time Emmy candidate, and Bill Hader, who plays the title character.The screen shows, among others:winner of two Golden Globes, Henry Winkler and Stephen Root.

programme.title: Marmalade
programme.desc: The quiet Baron (Joe Keery) is sent to prison.She shares a cell with Otis (Aldis Hodge), who has escaped several times from prisons.Initially reluctant, the boy agrees to help him get released when the boy offers him $250,000.When asked where he got the money, Baron tells his story.He lived in a small town with his bedridden mother, Eda (Amy Warner).He supported her and himself by working at the post office.However, he lost his job when he refused to cut his hair.Baron's life was changed by the arrival of the hit Marmalade (Camila Morrone), traumatized by her childhood spent in a foster family, in town.Gradually their relationship became closer.Fascinated by the girl, the simple-minded Baron agreed to rob a bank with her, especially since he lacked money to pay for his mother's medicines.Unfortunately, the plan failed because Marmalade started the jump impulsively.In addition, her actions led to a series of tragic events.

programme.title: The Knick
programme.desc: New York, the first years of the 20th century.Brilliant surgeon Dr. John Thackery (Clive Owen) leads a brave team of young medics at Knickerbocker Hospital.The doctor introduces pioneering medical solutions while struggling with cocaine addiction.His team is making breakthroughs in medicine at a time when antibiotics do not yet exist and patient mortality is terrifyingly high.The group of distinguished medical staff includes, among others:protégé Everett Gallinger (Eric Johnson) and Algernon Edwards (Andre Holland), a promising surgeon from Europe who was included in the team against Thackery's wishes.The series is directed by Oscar winner Steven Soderbergh.
